newsitem.title: SPAIN: Gas Natural net seen rising 15pct annually.
newsitem.headline: Gas Natural net seen rising 15pct annually.

text.p: Net profits at Spanish gas group Gas Natural are seen rising 15.2 percent annually between 1996 and 2000, said brokerage Agesban on Thursday.
It expected dividends to rise 14.7 percent annually during the same period.
It said the optimistic medium- and long-term outlook was based on Gas Natural's huge 88 percent Spanish market share, in an industry likely to grow given European Community energy policy.
The group's proven ability to control costs and above-average profitability, coupled with strategic assets in the Magreb and with group Enagas were also key to the focus.
